Install RevitTagAlign for Revit 2023
====================================

QUICK (recommended)
1. Extract this zip to a folder
2. Right-click Install.bat -> Run as administrator (or normal)
3. Close and reopen Revit 2023
4. Ribbon tab: Tag Align

Install.bat copies files to:
  %AppData%\Autodesk\Revit\Addins\2023\
and Unblocks them (fixes error 0x80131515 / FileLoadException).

MANUAL
1. Copy RevitTagAlign.dll + RevitTagAlign.addin to:
   %AppData%\Autodesk\Revit\Addins\2023\
2. IMPORTANT - unblock the DLL:
   Right-click RevitTagAlign.dll -> Properties -> check "Unblock" -> Apply -> OK
   (or PowerShell: Unblock-File "...\RevitTagAlign.dll")
3. Restart Revit

Error 0x80131515 means Windows blocked a file downloaded from the internet.
It is NOT a Revit version mismatch. Unblock fixes it.

Settings (auto-created, do not create manually):
  %AppData%\Roaming\RevitTagAlign\AlignConfig.xml
